newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures up in nearby contracts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures up in nearby contracts.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange wheat futures regained momentum on Thursday with the nearby March contract rising sharply in response to tight feedgrain supply.
March 1997 rose by A$5.00 a tonne to A$186.00 on 10 lots.
The more distant January 1998, however, edged back by 50 cents to A$163.50 on two lots traded.
Other contracts did not trade but settlement prices for nearer-term contracts advanced in line with the March rise.
Brokers said the market rise reflected a supply squeeze.
"The sharp rise shows how short the whole market is," one broker said. It could remain so for months, he said.
